from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0036.png").convert("RGB"))
# legs have blue/grey tint where R < 100
mask = (img[320:420, 230:310, 0] < 100) & (img[320:420, 230:310, 2] > 70)
import scipy.ndimage as ndi
lbl, n = ndi.label(mask)
print(f"Components: {n}")
for i in range(1, n+1):
    pts = np.argwhere(lbl == i)
    if len(pts) > 20:
        max_v = pts[:, 0].max() + 320
        mean_u = pts[pts[:, 0] == pts[:, 0].max(), 1].mean() + 230
        print(f"Leg comp {i}: size={len(pts)}, bottom u={mean_u:.1f}, v={max_v}")
'
